referenceFunction.generalComment: Coal use per tkm estimated from energy content in diesel consumed in diesel locomotives and a factor 6 lower efficiency for steam locomotives compared to diesel locomotives. Emissions are based on the dataset "hard coal, burned in coal mine power plant" and 24 MJ/kg LHV. However, emissions to air but CO2, NOx, N2O and CH4 have been arbitrarily increased by a factor of 2 per MJ, CO by a factor of 5, particles by a factor of 10, whereas ashes have been decreased by a factor of 2 compared to small coal mine power plants. This dataset should not be used for comparisons of locomotive types nor of transport means across different countries but only when transport is not a major contributor to total environmental burdens of a process or product being analyzed.; UUID: cc4ab222-ff65-3a7d-9850-a2f2905d6b5a
